items.question: How is Buzznerd marketing different from a normal ad agency?
items.answer: Buzznerd builds campaigns around your live inventory instead of a generic keyword list. Ads, remarketing, and landing pages reflect what's actually on your lot, and performance is measured all the way to the sale.

items.question: Which marketing channels does Buzznerd manage?
items.answer: Buzznerd manages Google Ads, Meta remarketing, email campaigns, social promotions, and inventory-connected landing pages — all tied to your live inventory and product data.

items.question: Can Buzznerd tie marketing spend to actual sales?
items.answer: Yes. Channel-to-sale attribution connects each lead and sale back to the channel that drove it, so you can see which campaigns produce real deals rather than just clicks.

items.question: Do I need a Buzznerd website to use the marketing service?
items.answer: Marketing works best alongside a Buzznerd website and the AI platform because campaigns run on live inventory data, but we'll discuss options for your current setup during a demo.

items.question: How do campaigns stay current with my inventory?
items.answer: Campaigns are connected to live inventory, parts, and product data, so as units sell or arrive, the ads and landing pages reflect what's actually available.
